announcements.title: Self-improving bot requests
announcements.message: If I don't understand a Telegram question, I now save it as a feature request for the periodic ChatGPT feature builder.
announcements.example: Ask a new soccer-bot question; if unsupported, I'll queue it and tell you the request ID.

announcements.title: Telegram-managed encrypted setup
announcements.message: You can now set or change your pickup RSVP/owner name through Telegram, and /setup shows any user information I still need.

announcements.title: Reliability and privacy upgrades
announcements.message: BallerWatch now has automatic component recovery, a unified manual smoke test, and privacy-redacted storage for unsupported Telegram questions.
announcements.example: Ask /setup or try a new unsupported question.

announcements.title: Versioned BallerWatch releases
announcements.message: BallerWatch now tracks every product change with a SemVer version and release history. Automated ChatGPT changes must bump the version and record what changed.

announcements.title: Default league teams
announcements.message: League monitoring now bootstraps Third Touch FC first and PhoSaiGon second on a clean setup; you can still add, remove, or rename monitored teams in Telegram.
announcements.example: what league teams are you monitoring?
